messages:
morgan_dev: Heads-up — I'd like to land PR #19021 (hotfix: kv-cache eviction) today if possible. Region EU-west has a short maintenance in ~2h but this change is safe-rollback, low-risk. Can I get an approval + a CI rerun?
kevin_sre: :eyes: maintenance window starts at 18:30 UTC. If it lands right before maintenance there's a risk of queued deploys. Do you need to land before that or can it wait until the 3h rebase window?
tara_pm: Impact check — this fixes a small mem-leak on dedicated nodes; customer-facing for one account but not a wide outage. If we delay there's a minor revenue impact.
morgan_dev: Prefer land before maintenance to avoid a second deploy later. I can coordinate a manual canary and rollback plan.
sam_reviews: Quick skimed — code looks fine but please add a single-line test covering the eviction edge case. tiny change.
morgan_dev: Adding test now, pushing.
ci-bot: Build queued for commit 6a7b2c8 — running test matrix (linux, mac, unit). Status: running.
ci-bot: linux/unit: passed. mac/unit: flaky-try (rerun recommended). windows/integration: running.
kevin_sre: If mac is flaky we'll need a green matrix for canary to be comfortable. Suggest run matrix with `--focus=unit` to unblock, then run integration canary post-merge.
morgan_dev: Re-ran with focused units per advice: `./scripts/ci.sh --focus=unit && ./scripts/ci.sh --smoke canary`
```
# local snippet
git checkout pr/19021
git commit -m "add eviction unit test"
git push origin HEAD:pr/19021
```

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by morgan_dev: commit 9f2d1b4 — linux/unit: passed, mac/unit: passed, windows/integration: running.
tara_pm: If windows integration completes ok, I'm comfortable with a pre-maintenance deploy as long as Kevin gives the green for canary.
kevin_sre: I'll stand by the canary at 18:00 UTC. If canary is healthy for 30m we can proceed with rolling deploy before maintenance. If any regressions -> rollback. :thumbsup:
morgan_dev: Thanks — starting manual canary at 18:00. Will post short summary after 30m.
sam_reviews: Approved. :white_check_mark: nice tests.
ci-bot: windows/integration: passed.
morgan_dev: Canary report: 30m steady, no increased error rates, latency unchanged. Metrics: infra.p99 82ms -> 85ms (noise). Rolling deploy starting in 5m.
kevin_sre: I'll be on-call during the rollout. If anything spikes I'll pause and trigger rollback.
tara_pm: Thanks team. Post-rollout, confirm we won't overlap maintenance job that cleans caches.
morgan_dev: Confirmed — scheduled jobs will start after 19:00 UTC. Deploy complete, PR merged. :party_parrot: 
ci-bot: Deploys completed to 3/3 regions. Rollback point recorded.
kevin_sre: All looks stable. Closing loop — good job coordinating.
